notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Oklahoma City is still without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Aday Mara and Jaylin Williams, so the offense runs almost entirely through him; he has played 36 to 38 minutes in his last three games. Alex Caruso is back from a hip impingement tonight, which adds a guard but not a scorer.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: Towns is questionable with knee inflammation after scoring 30 in 29 minutes on Sunday. OG Anunoby is out and Josh Hart is also questionable, so if Towns plays he is the clear second option next to Jalen Brunson; if he sits, Andre Drummond started at center the last time Towns missed a game.
notes.Jalen Brunson: Brunson is the one healthy constant for New York with OG Anunoby and Jordan Clarkson out and Towns, Josh Hart and Miles McBride all questionable. He played 36 minutes on November 21, the last game Towns missed.
notes.Naz Reid: Reid has played 42, 39 and 38 minutes in his last three games because Charlotte is without Ryan Kalkbrenner at center and Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder on the wing. All three are out or doubtful again tonight against Chicago.
notes.Ty Jerome: Jerome has started both games since returning from a hip injury and played 29 minutes on Monday with Cameron Boozer out. Boozer, Jerami Grant, Scotty Pippen Jr. and GG Jackson are all out again tonight, so the Memphis offense still leans on him.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: Wembanyama is questionable with low back tightness after sitting Monday, his first missed game of the season. De'Aaron Fox is also questionable, and Dylan Harper and Tobias Harris are out, so watch San Antonio's late lineup news.
notes.Stephon Castle: Castle ran the offense for 37 minutes with 11 assists on Monday with Wembanyama, Fox and Dylan Harper all out. Harper is out again tonight and Wembanyama and Fox are questionable, so his role depends on who suits up in Portland.
notes.Yaxel Lendeborg: Lendeborg is questionable with an illness. With Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis all out, he has been the main option and has played 30 to 34 minutes in each of his last four games.
notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: Giannis is questionable with right groin tendinitis after missing Sunday, but he went through most of Tuesday's practice and said he felt great. This is the early 5 PM ET game at Philadelphia, off the main slate.
notes.Joel Embiid: Embiid is doubtful with an illness after also missing Monday, so Philadelphia likely goes without him again in the early game against Miami.
notes.Josh Hart: Hart is questionable with a right shoulder sprain after a season-high 39 minutes on Sunday with OG Anunoby out. Anunoby is out again tonight, so if Hart plays he keeps a heavy-minutes role.
notes.Jaden McDaniels: McDaniels has carried a bigger load with Anthony Edwards out, playing 34 to 39 minutes in his last four games, and he scored a career-high 34 on Monday. Donte DiVincenzo and Jaylen Clark are also still out, so the wing minutes stay with him.
notes.Alex Caruso: Caruso is available tonight after missing three games with a hip impingement. Before that he left his last game after 9 minutes, so his minutes could be limited.
notes.Taylor Hendricks: Hendricks has played 27 and 24 minutes off the bench in the two games without Cameron Boozer, but he scored only eight points total in those games. Boozer and Jerami Grant are out again, so the minutes should be there.
notes.Andre Drummond: Drummond started at center and played 23 minutes when Karl-Anthony Towns missed November 21, then played 19 minutes off the bench on Sunday with OG Anunoby out. Towns is questionable tonight, which is what decides Drummond's role.
notes.Danny Wolf: Wolf has started Brooklyn's last two games over Egor Demin and played 25 to 26 minutes in both. Nolan Traore is out with a hamstring strain, which keeps the starting group the same.
notes.Bennett Stirtz: Stirtz played 32 minutes when Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sat on November 22 and 19 minutes when he returned on Monday. Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams and Aday Mara are still out, but Alex Caruso's return tonight could take some of his guard minutes.
notes.Isaiah Stewart: Stewart has played 21 minutes off the bench in both games without Cameron Boozer. He is a backup big, so Boozer's absence has not changed his role much.
notes.Jaylen Wells: Wells has started every recent game for Memphis but his minutes fell to 20 on Monday. Cameron Boozer, Jerami Grant and Scotty Pippen Jr. are all out again.
notes.Grant Williams: Williams is off the injury report after missing two games for planned hamstring management. He started and played 30 minutes on November 17, and Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder are still out, so Charlotte has wing minutes for him.
notes.Olivier-Maxence Prosper: Prosper has played 19 to 24 minutes off the bench in Memphis's last three games, with Jerami Grant and Cameron Boozer out. Both are out again tonight.
Brown moved into Brooklyn's starting lineup on Monday and played 29 minutes, while Egor Demin came off the bench. Nolan Traore is out again, so Brown should keep the point guard job.
notes.Brandon Williams: Williams is questionable after missing six games with a left hamstring strain. With Stephen Curry out, Golden State needs guards, so he could slide back into the rotation if cleared.
